title.narrative: UNDP Stöd till stabilisering i Tchadsjöregionen 2025-2028
UNDP Support to stabilization process in the Lake Chad Basin region 2025-2028 - RSF 2.0

description.narrative: Detta är ett finansiellt stöd till UNDPs regionala stabiliseringsfacilitet (RSF) 2.0 samt den nya finansieringsmekanismen SMDF (Special Multi-Partner Delivery Fund) för Tchadsjöregionen 2025-2028. Sida stöttade RSF i två faser sedan 2019 med icke-öronmärkta medel och bedömer att det finns starka skäl att stödja utfasningen av programmet, stärka uppnådda resultat liksom lokalt ägarskap och kapacitet att driva och samordna insatser som bidrar till stabilisering och utveckling i regionen.

This is a financial support to UNDP's Regional Stabilization Facility (RSF) 2.0 and the new Special Multi-Partner Delivery Fund (SMDF) for the Lake Chad Basin region 2025-2028. Sida supported the RSF in two phases since 2019 with non-earmarked funds and assesses that there are strong reasons to support the phasing out of the programme, strengthening the results achieved as well as local ownership and capacity to steer and coordinate efforts that contribute to stabilization and development in the region.

The following is a quote from the RSF prodoc:
Intermediary project outcome: By 2028, stabilization interventions have improved stability through strengthened social contract in insurgency-affected areas in the Lake Chad Basin.
Indicative Output(s) with gender marker :
Output 1: By 2028, people in targeted RSF areas benefit from improved, gender-responsive security services and have better access to justice. Gender marker: 2
Output 2: By 2028, people in targeted RSF areas benefit from enhanced cross-border trade infrastructure and expanded gender-responsive livelihood opportunities. Gender marker: 2
Output 3: By 2028, people in targeted RSF areas have better access to functioning, quality and gender-responsive essential service facilities. Gender marker: 3
Output 4: By 2028, communities and national and regional institutions are better able to cooperate across borders and within the region. Gender marker: 2
Further copied from prodoc with regards to the interventions expected results:
Overall, the RSF programme contributes to Regional Outcome 4 of the UNDP Regional Programme Document for Africa (2022-2025): African citizens (especially women and youth), supported by the African Union and regional economic communities and regional mechanisms, achieve measurable progress towards sustainable peace.
More specifically, the programme-level intermediary outcome is that by 2028, stabilization interventions have improved stability through a strengthened social contract in insurgency-affected areas in the Lake Chad Basin.
To achieve this outcome, the RSF programme will deliver four outputs :
By 2028, people in targeted RSF areas benefit from improved, gender-responsive security services and have better access to justice.
By 2028, people benefit from enhanced cross-border trade infrastructure, productive networks, and expanded gender-responsive livelihood opportunities.
By 2028, people have better access to functioning, quality and gender-responsive essential service facilities.
By 2028, communities and national and regional institutions are better able to cooperate across borders and within the region.
The prodoc goes on to present options for programmatic interventions to achieve the outputs in different country window contexts, noting that due to the challenging and changing context, high levels of flexibility and context-specific design will be needed in the implementation stage.
The following is a quote from the SMDF prodoc :
"Intermediary outcome: By 2028, the RSS-RR is developed, financed and implemented in the Lake Chad Basin region in an effective and inclusive manner.
Indicative Output(s) with Gender Marker:
Output 1: The Lake Chad Basin Commission has institutional capacities to steer the implementation of the regional stabilization strategy RS-SRR in a gender-responsive and inclusive manner. Gender Marker: 2
The followin two outputs refer to components 2 and 3 of the MSDF to which Swedish funds will not be used.
Output 2: By 2028, exits from Boko Haram are managed across the Lake Chad Basin region in a harmonized manner. Gender Marker 2
Output 3: By 2028, actors across humanitarian, peace and development nexus work towards joint outcomes. Gender Marker: 2"
